items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Stinger cleared; MRI ok, practiced, off report.

items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams (hamstring) for MNF vs Eagles. Tyson Bagent Q (concussion) after practicing.
items.why: Hamstring; official ruling. Bagent full participant but Q.
items.implication: Bagent or third-string QB; fade Bears pass catchers somewhat.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; ETR projects him out. Davante Adams sees elevated routes/targets without him.
items.why: Hip/groin; limited progress per McVay; no practice all week.
items.implication: Adams WR1 usage spike; avoid Nacua.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes sans Nacua historically.

items.text: Nico Collins OUT (hamstring). Dalton Schultz saw 28% target share last week without him.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% route targets last week; IND allows 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe). Jaylen Warren to lead RB group per coach; ETR/Levitan project Warren in despite Q shoulder.
items.why: Toe; ruled out. Coach: Warren leads, gets breathers.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with checkdown volume from Rodgers.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + zillion checkdowns expected; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN as of now despite listings. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.implication: Start if active; monitor early reports.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full roles if cleared.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow). Mariota starts; McLaurin still viable longer-term but tough SEA matchup.
items.implication: Mariota QB streamer; McLaurin 25% TS historically with him but sit vs SEA.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks OUT/IR (core). Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back; AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Core; placed on IR after limited games.
items.opportunity: Hubbard RB14 utilization already; full lead role.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (avg top 25th %ile sim outcomes) for main slate.
items.why: Elite matchup/usage; record ceiling in sims.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads; vertical game failed so expect checkdown spam. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in. Backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle OUT; LP practice.
items.implication: Warren strong start/RB2 with receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; high snap share.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL: highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% TS last week sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yards allowed. Also LOVE Chase Brown, Olave, Watson, Purdy, Mahomes.
items.why: Usage spikes + matchups (Olave air yards vs LV; Watson RZ; Purdy/Mahomes smash spots).

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps); also HATE Stevenson (post-fumble low snaps), McLaurin (SEA D), Odunze, Mayfield.
items.why: Poor roles/matchups (Etienne committee; Stevenson 31% snaps post-fumble; McLaurin low implied total + tough D).
items.opportunity: Henderson narrowed gap but Stevenson still ranked higher by Berry.

items.text: Davante Adams 142 routes sans Nacua as Ram: 60 targets (42% rate). Recent games without: big yardage/TDs.
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 this week if Nacua out.
